subject: general
question: Zubeda’s income is ₹1,20,000. She spends 20% on accommodation, 35% on household expenses, and 25% on other activities. She saves the remaining amount. What are her total savings?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total expenses = 20% + 35% + 25% = 80%

Remaining = 20% (savings)

Savings = 20% of 120000

= 120000 × 20 ÷ 100 = 24000

**∴ Answer = 24000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income = 120000, Expenses = 20%, 35%, 25%

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income − Total expenses

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total expense % = 20 + 35 + 25 = 80%

⇒ Expense amount = 80% of 120000

⇒ = (80 ÷ 100) × 120000 = 96000

⇒ Savings = 120000 − 96000

⇒ = 24000

**∴ The correct answer is 24000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Sum Rule

Total percentage = 100%, remaining = savings

Savings Formula

Savings = Income × Remaining%

Expense Calculation

Expenses = Sum of all percentage expenditures

Quick Tip

Find leftover percentage directly instead of subtracting amounts
